title: /composition — configuration field
bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

Root-owned, client-resolved master/include graph. It yields one fully validated policy without uploading personal configuration.

## Constraints and authority

Public schema path: `/composition`. The complete selected schema branch and native semantic validator determine admissibility; validate the whole policy, not this value alone. Branch-specific requirements and native permission/identity checks still apply; schema input acceptance alone is not authority. Use synthetic declarations in the preview and keep credential bytes outside policy.

## Expected result

The local proposal contains the intended declaration and passes complete-policy validation. Browser Save retains a local draft; it does not activate native configuration, fetch a provider value or grant remote access. Use the corresponding guide for actual native operations.

## Recovery

On pin, trust, dependency, privacy or equality-lock failure, repair the trusted master/source under its owner. Do not select an unverified cache, discard a lock or upload private fragments to make resolution succeed.
capabilityStatus: A declared configuration field; browser editing is local. Actual native behavior depends on the selected schema/runtime, adapter and authorization.
